post_text:
My paper, LumoTree: Path-Parallel Speculative Verification for Hybrid Language Models, is now on arXiv.

It brings together the engineering work behind my earlier speculative-decoding blogs: GPU kernels, state and cache correctness, and serving measurements.

The core design verifies candidate token paths in parallel, then commits the accepted path consistently across recurrent state, convolution history, and attention caches.

On DGX Spark, recorded-request replay on two corpora showed 7.7–11.8% higher throughput than native five-token MTP. The live coding-agent study did not establish faster task completion.

Paper: https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.23900
